## Checklist

- [ ] `make fmt lint test docs` passes and the regenerated `docs/` is committed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `(Unreleased)`.
- [ ] Acceptance tests were run against a non-production environment, or are marked "not run" (maintainers run them before release).
- [ ] No secrets in configuration, examples, tests or logs.
